categories.name: Algebra
categories.description: Quadratics, algebraic identities, sequences and series, exponent and logarithm rules, percentages, growth and decay, variation and coordinate geometry.

categories.name: Geometry
categories.description: Areas and perimeters of flat shapes, circles and arcs, and volumes and surface areas of solids.

categories.name: Trigonometry
categories.description: Right-angled triangles, the sine and cosine rules, trigonometric identities, angle units and polar coordinates.

categories.name: Calculus and analysis
categories.description: Differentiation rules, standard integrals, the fundamental theorem, Taylor approximations and numerical methods.

categories.name: Vectors and matrices
categories.description: Magnitudes, dot and cross products, angles between vectors, projections, determinants, inverses and eigenvalues.

categories.name: Statistics and probability
categories.description: Averages and spread, counting, probability rules, common distributions, confidence intervals, correlation and regression.

categories.name: Mechanics
categories.description: Motion, forces, energy, momentum, circular motion, oscillations, gravitation, pressure and materials.

categories.name: Waves, optics and sound
categories.description: Wave speed, refraction, lenses, interference and diffraction, the Doppler effect, sound levels and photons.

categories.name: Electricity and magnetism
categories.description: Circuits, power, capacitors, electric fields, magnetic forces and fields, induction, transformers and AC circuits.

categories.name: Thermodynamics and gases
categories.description: Heating and phase changes, the gas laws, thermal expansion, radiation, heat engines and heat transfer.

categories.name: Modern physics
categories.description: Mass-energy equivalence, radioactive decay, the photoelectric effect, atomic spectra, special relativity and quantum limits.

categories.name: Chemistry
categories.description: Amount of substance, concentrations, acids and bases, yields, reaction rates, equilibria, thermodynamics and electrochemistry.

categories.name: Finance
categories.description: Interest, present and future value, loans and annuities, investment appraisal, profit, VAT and depreciation.

categories.name: Units and everyday
categories.description: Speed and travel, fuel and energy costs, temperature and unit conversions, prices, discounts and body mass index.
